intent: Be the element that actually scrolls inside a MessageScroller, and the one whose user input decides whether the scroller keeps following the end.
typical_uses: The single scrolling region of a MessageScroller, holding its MessageScrollerContent

dont_use_when.situation: A scrolling region outside a MessageScroller

invariants.text: The viewport renders with `role="region"`, `aria-label="Messages"` and `tabIndex={0}`, each replaced when the consumer passes its own, so the transcript is a named landmark a keyboard user can focus and scroll.

While `preserveScrollOnPrepend` is on, items inserted before the first item leave the first item with a `messageId` that was in view at the same offset from the viewport's top instead of pushing it down.

a11y.by: message-scroller.test.tsx finds the viewport with getByRole('region', { name: 'Messages' }); the primitive's Viewport supplies the role, the default aria-label and tabIndex 0

good.title: A viewport with its own accessible name

bad.title: Items written straight into the viewport
bad.why: The scroller watches only the children of MessageScrollerContent: an item outside it is never counted or anchored, `scrollToMessage` to it queues a jump that never happens, and it sits outside the content's bottom-anchoring layout.
